tips.text: Welcome! I am your financial advisor. <think> Let's keep track of your money together.
Did you record all your expenses today? The 90% of people don't know where their money goes. You do. That's worth a lot.
Small daily expenses add up fast. A coffee here, a snack there... <surprised> It can be hundreds per month!
Great job staying on budget this month! <wink> Keep it up and you'll have a solid emergency fund before you know it.
Remember: paying yourself first is the oldest trick in the book. Set aside savings before spending on anything else.
